calibration.units: standard deviations of the paired run-to-run difference

detectable_effect.assumption: sd(paired difference) = sqrt(2) x sd(A0), i.e. the candidate's seed noise is the same size as A0's and independent of it. The seed moves only initialisation and batch order, so independence holds by construction; equal size is an assumption, and a noisier candidate makes the detectable effect larger.

evaluation_noise.verdict: the measured spread is training variance, not scoring noise
